items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: Ink Williams didn't want me to be friends with Ralph Scull, because Ralph Scull was so popular.

ctx.x: He was popular as a football player, that's how I knew him. That's right. But I knew him, I knew him only in the record business and music-

No, and- and- and we- Ink Williams didn't want me to be friends with Ralph Scull, because Ralph Scull was so popular. Yeah. Not only popular, but I mean, he- I guess he was important, more important than ink.
Mm-hmm. He was a ball player, you said? Yeah.
